## Earlier teaching

::: {.entry}
[Math Speeder Upper Course — Introduction to Multivariable Calculus]{.entry-title} [Summer 2021]{.entry-date}
[*Instructor and Curriculum Designer*]{.entry-meta}

A fully online introductory multivariable calculus course: 22 lectures, homework with
solutions, quizzes, two midterms, three projects, and a final exam. Ten students in the first
cohort, and new students still work through the now fully asynchronous material every year.
Built to be accessible to any student regardless of background or socioeconomic status.
:::

a midterm, and a final exam.
:::
